name: Player_UpdateAim
notes: Attract-demo auto-gun when 0x009C71C4==1 (state 5): roll rand()%60 < (0x009C7006 live enemies ? 6 : 1); aim x=(rand()%150)*2-150, y=(rand()%100)*2-100; no-fire stores the record pointer's low word as aim. Then player+0x18=0, +0x10/+0x14 = (float)rec+4/+6. Replayed 513/513 frames (shooting_test). Ported: DemoAutoGun

name: Player_Trigger
notes: Normal weapon: fired && valid && ammo && 0x009C8E00 -> ammo-- (not state 5 / infinite 0x009C9FD9), pending player+0x18=1, Shot_BuildRay, Shot_SpawnTracer, sound 0x004EC8BC[p]; gun off screen with ammo!=6 -> Player_Reload; pad reload button. Ported decision: PlayerTrigger

name: Player_TriggerSpecial
notes: Mode 0x009CA08C==1 weapons (0x009A2240+p*0x14): cooldown/burst tables 0x00579EDD, rand spread (+-63/+-47 px) for weapon 1

name: Player_Reload
notes: ammo=6 (or weapon ammo in mode 1), empty flag 0, sound 0x3E16A9 when 0x009C8E00

name: Player_ReloadSpecial
notes: Special-weapon reload (0x00416420); weapon sound 0x004EC9C0

name: Player_Task
notes: Per player (task +0x34 = p): state callbacks +0x7C/+0x80, forces lives=1 in state 5, Player_Trigger/Special if lives>0, Hud_UpdateCrosshair, HUD; first rand consumer of a frame

name: Player_AddScore
notes: player+0x0C += points (x2 for mode-1 weapon 2), clamped >= 0

name: Player_AddLife
notes: lives +1 up to 0x009A2440 (mode 1: 0x009A2245) else +300 points

name: Player_SetState
signature: void __cdecl (short state, int setFn, Task* playerTask)
notes: player+0x02 = state; task fn = 0x00579CD0[state*5] when setFn

name: Shot_BuildRay
signature: void __cdecl (int player, float x, float y)
notes: Block 0x009A2CB8+p*0x68: view dir normalize(x,y,-F) (+0x3C), world origin/dir via camera matrix 0x009A6040+ctx*0x1A4, -pitch/-yaw and sin/cos at +0x18..+0x2C. F = 0x009A2D70. Ported: MakeShotRay

name: Shot_RayDistance
signature: int __cdecl (int player, float x, float y, float z, float r)
notes: 1 if the view-space point is within r of the shot line, else -1. Ported: ShotRayDistance; verified 7/7 enemy hits + 1/1 prop hit

name: Shot_SpawnTracer
notes: Fills per-player ring records (6 each, index 0x009CA09C) at 0x009A2960 (screen dir), 0x009A2460 (world point + velocity), 0x009A2700 (mode 1 weapons)

name: Hit_Init
notes: Coll_Init, creates the hit task (fn 0x004044A0 -> body 0x00404570, size 0x34), clears target/hit lists

name: Hit_Task
notes: Not a Ghidra function (entry jmp at 0x004044A0). Per player with shot pending: test all targets (0x00404A00 / 0x00404630), Hit_TestLevel, Hit_Deliver; hit flag 0x009C9010[p]; then Hit_CopyTargets and count 0

name: Hit_RegisterTarget
notes: Skip if +0x34&0x8000; needs flag 0x10 or view z (+0x78) <= 0. Entry {obj, +0x34, +0x12C,+0x130,+0x134 (world collision centre)} at 0x0059D8E8, count 0x005A4C80; flag 0x10: +0x150 *= camera matrix. Ported predicate: IsShotTarget

name: Hit_CopyTargets
notes: 0x0059D8E8 -> 0x005A3098 (object-object collision list, count 0x0059D8E4)

name: Hit_RemoveTarget
notes: Clears obj's entry in the copied list 0x005A3098

name: Hit_TestObjectSphere
notes: Sphere (+0x70, r +0x124); flag 0x80 skeleton -> Hit_TestSkeleton; else entry with key ftol(-z*10)

name: Hit_TestSkeleton
notes: Walks skeleton 0x004E0430[obj+0x1F4] children with Hit_TestNodeRecursive (sets 0x009A26A0)

name: Hit_TestNodeRecursive
notes: Active node records (obj+0x20C+slot*0x90): flag 0x10 -> Hit_TestNodeMesh (mesh +0x88 != -1), else Hit_TestNodeSphere

name: Hit_TestNodeSphere
notes: Node view pos rec+0x68..+0x70, radius rec+0x78 (skipped if 0), key ftol(-z*10), entry flags = rec+0x74

name: Hit_TestNodeMesh
notes: Node matrix (rec+0x28) x camera -> 0x0059D898; mesh rec+0x88; Hit_RayVsMesh; entry flags | 0x40

name: Hit_TestObjectMesh
notes: Matrix +0x150, mesh +0x14C; normal rotated by obj angles +0x64..+0x6C; Hit_AddMeshHit

name: Hit_RayVsMesh
notes: World segment origin -> origin + 1000*dir (0x004C49C4) -> Coll_SegmentVsMesh

name: Hit_AddMeshHit
notes: entry obj/flags|0x40 then Hit_AddPointHit

name: Hit_TestLevel
notes: Segment vs level collision meshes 0x009C7040[count task 0x009C701C+0x60] and 0x009CA0C0[+0x61]; Hit_AddLevelHit

name: Hit_AddLevelHit
notes: entry obj = 0 flags = 0 then Hit_AddPointHit

name: Hit_AddPointHit
notes: Entry from hit point 0x009CAC54/58/50, normal 0x009CAC64.., material 0x009CAC40; key = ftol(-viewZ(hit)*10); flags |= 0x10

name: Hit_Deliver
notes: Nearest entry: obj+0x34 |= (2<<p)|8, obj+0x190+p = node slot (0x20 node) or 1; node flags; with hit point -> Hit_RecordImpact; mode 1 weapon 3 -> effect 0x53

name: Hit_SortByDepth
notes: Stable LSD radix sort (2 passes of 8 bits = key bits 0-15) of {key,index} 0x0059ECD8 via 0x005A4488. Ported: SortHitKeys

name: Hit_RecordImpact
notes: 0x009A2C40+p*0x1C = {point, material, normal}; Fx_SpawnAt(point, material, material in {5,0x37}, p)

name: Coll_SegmentVsMesh
notes: Inverse of 0x0059D898 applied to both points, 0x004AAA40(start,end,mesh 0x005A4C88); hit point back to world

name: Coll_SegmentVsMeshId
signature: int __cdecl (float sx,float sy,float sz,float ex,float ey,float ez,int mesh)
notes: Sets 0x009CAC40 material, 0x009CAC50.. point, 0x009CAC64.. normal; callers 0x00404B80, 0x00404F60, 0x004053B0

name: Coll_SegmentVsObjects
signature: int __cdecl (float sx,float sy,float sz,float ex,float ey,float ez)
notes: Segment vs flag-0x10/0x40 objects of 0x005A3098 and level meshes

name: Coll_SphereVsObjectMeshes
notes: Used by Enemy_PushOut; result 0x009CAC4C depth, 0x009CAC64 normal

name: Coll_SphereVsObjects
notes: Sphere vs object spheres (list words +8..+0x10 centre; radius obj+0x128); used by Enemy_PushOut

name: Coll_Init
notes: Creates the level-collision task (0x00406010; 0x009C701C) and resets mesh lists

name: Actor_RegisterShootable
notes: Current obj 0x009A26A0: +0x70..+0x78 = view x (+0x100..+0x108), Hit_RegisterTarget, +0x104 += arg

name: Enemy_HandleShot
notes: If +0x34&8: Enemy_TakeShots; per shooter with damage: hit kind 0x009A58F8[p], Enemy_HitReaction, voice, death state (+0x1310 = 6/9)

name: Enemy_TakeShots
notes: Enemy_ShotOrder; per player bit (2<<p): node 0x009A2D88[p] = obj+0x190+p, Enemy_ApplyDamage unless +0x34&0x100; clears shot bits

name: Enemy_ShotOrder
notes: 0x009C8908/0C = processing order from 0x009C7000 (0 P1, 1 P2, 2 both: rand()&1 at ret 0x004093E2)

name: Enemy_ApplyDamage
notes: Zone/part tables 0x004C7160[skel], damage 0x004C8350[skel] (+0x004D0D84 bonus), HP +0x11C; dead flag 0x4000000 + 80 pts; slot 2: +120 + streak (player+0x22 += 10), else +10; hits player+0x26

name: Enemy_SubtractHp
notes: obj+0x11C -= damage unless +0x34 & 0x1000

name: Enemy_PlayVoice
notes: 0 hurt (rand ret 0x0040A737), 1 death (0x0040A778), 2 death slot 2 (0x0040A7B9), 3, 4

name: Enemy_HitReaction
notes: Per hit kind: effects 0x00407340 types 2/3/0x51 at the node, knock-back 0x00407310, sounds

name: Enemy_PushOut
notes: Enemy-vs-object separation with Coll_SphereVsObjects / Coll_SphereVsObjectMeshes (not damage)

name: Enemy_Task
notes: Enemy actor body: Enemy_HandleShot, state fn 0x00592AE8[+0x1310], Actor_RegisterShootable(4.0), callbacks

name: Gun_UpdateRecords
notes: Shot input 0x009C8800 -> gun records 0x009C8FC0+p*0x28 (calibrated centred aim +4/+6, valid +0x10, fired +0x14); pad: Gun_MovePadCursor; mode 6 fixed calibration

name: Gun_ResetRecords
notes: Clears aim/fired; copies calibration from 0x009C9FB8/0x009C9FC8 + p*0x7C by 0x009C911C

name: Gun_MovePadCursor
notes: Pad/keyboard float cursor (x2 with button), clamp +-320/+-240, button 0x009C9028

name: Gun_CalibrateClamped
signature: int __cdecl (int raw, short* cal, short* out, int min, int max, int* ok)
notes: Gun_Calibrate then range check (0 and ok=0 outside)

name: Gun_Calibrate
signature: int __cdecl (int raw, short* cal, short* out)
notes: Piecewise linear through 3 points, raw -= cal[3] (+0x009A6694 if negative). Ported: GunCalibrate

name: Player_GetInputKind
notes: -1 none, 0 gun (+0x125==1), 1/2/3 pad variants from +0x124

name: Input_SlotToPlayer
notes: slot 0 -> 0, 6 -> 1, else -1

name: Gun_ClearCursors
notes: Zeroes the pad cursors of all gun records

name: Game_ApplyState
notes: Pending state 0x007C17A0 -> 0x009C8E98; demo flag 0x009C71C4 = (state == 5); resets counters; players to 9 outside states 6/7

name: Letterbox_Start
notes: Creates Letterbox_Task (0x58)

name: Letterbox_Task
notes: State 0x009CA0F4 (table 0x00413C80): bars (model 0x93E at y +-0.35) and 0x009C8E00 = shooting allowed

name: Hud_DrawLives
notes: Life torches (sprites 0x6C2/0x6CA animated) from player+0x06 while 0x009CA0F4 == 2

name: Hud_DrawAmmo
notes: Bullets (sprite 0xA74) from player+0x1C

name: Fx_Task
notes: Draws model +0x60 at pos/angles/scale, +0x60++ each frame, ends after +0x64 (0x61: 29 frames)

name: Fx_SpawnFacingCamera
notes: Like Fx_Spawn for types 0x5A-0x5D (0x5A spawns 0x5B/0x5C/0x5D)

notes: Event actor kind 3 (0x00432FF0): Fx_SpawnAt(pos, 0x62) then ends; the stage-1 demo's 2830 splash

name: Prop_BreakableTask
notes: Breakable prop (radius 6): on +0x34&8 and +0x32C==0 -> sound, +0x32C=1, debris 0x004666B0 (task 0x004667A0); verified 1 hit in the demo
